measurement: Choose a Profile, then a Size. Profile: Slim (6 in. belt height) or Standard (8 in. belt height). Size by waist circumference: Small 26 to 34 in.; Medium 34 to 38 in.; Large 38 to 50 in.; XL 50 to 66 in. Measure waist circumference at the level of the iliac crest. XL requires belt extension MLSO-1EXT (Slim) or MLSO-2EXT (Standard), sold separately. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
